news.title: Chip Stocks Tumble as Government Bonds Edge Higher- Asia Market Wrap
news.description: A global selloff in semiconductor stocks deepened as investors retreated from one of the year’s hottest trades amid elevated bond yields and geopolitical uncertainty. Treasuries gained modestly following recent losses. Shares of Samsung and SK Hynix slumped more than 7% in Seoul, after losses in US chipmakers sent the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 5% on Tuesday, marking its worst session since late July.
